description: createMagicSignInLink mints the sign-in link identifier from Math.random() + Date.now() — a non-cryptographic, low-entropy source. Possession of that identifier grants one-click account access, so a predictable value is account takeover. The security relevance must be INFERRED from the access semantics (the code never uses the words token/secret/nonce/session/csrf); a competent reviewer must still flag it (CWE-330). This is the non-enumerated case that carries the over-suppression closure claim.
